name: Locked In
author: Pablo Nicolás Marín
description: Focus blocks in your Omarchy bar: a Pomodoro timer that mutes notifications, shields you from distracting apps and tracks time per project.

barWidget.description: Focus timer with per-project history: start a block, see what's left, open your stats

defaults.blocklist: youtube, discord, steam, reddit, x.com, instagram, twitch

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale; en and es force English or Spanish.

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: line shows the project and a progress bar; ring is a small ring and the time.

schema.label: Focus block (minutes)
schema.description: Length of a focus block. 5 to 120.

schema.label: Short break (minutes)
schema.description: Break after each focus block. 1 to 30.

schema.label: Long break (minutes)
schema.description: Longer break after several blocks. 5 to 60.

schema.label: Long break every
schema.description: Number of focus blocks before a long break. 2 to 8.

schema.label: Start breaks automatically
schema.description: Start the break as soon as a focus block ends.

schema.label: Start focus automatically
schema.description: Start the next focus block as soon as a break ends.

schema.label: Silence notifications
schema.description: Turn on do-not-disturb during focus blocks and show what arrived when the block ends.

schema.label: When a distraction opens
schema.description: warn asks you, hide moves the window away until the block ends, close closes it, off does nothing.

schema.label: Distractions
schema.defaultValue: youtube, discord, steam, reddit, x.com, instagram, twitch
schema.description: Comma-separated words matched against window classes and titles, so YouTube in a browser counts too.

schema.label: Island position
schema.description: bar grows the island over the centre of the bar; below shows it just under the bar.
